title.zh: 金融控股公司（指定金融控股公司）命令 2022
title.en: Financial Holding Companies (Designated Financial Holding Companies) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Financial Holding Companies (Designated Financial Holding Companies) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 1 July 2022.
2. Each financial holding company set out in the Schedule is designated as a designated financial holding company for the purposes of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Designated financial holding companies
1. DBS Group Holdings Ltd (UEN 199901152M)
2. Great Eastern Holdings Limited (UEN 199903008M)
3. [Deleted by S 246/2024 wef 01/04/2024]
4. Citystate Capital Asia Pte. Ltd. (UEN 200917889Z)
